steps.python:
p = ${tp0}
print('EMPTY', p)
assert p['page'] == 'task' and p['runs'] == 0 and p['run'] == '' and p['python_ready'], p
assert p['problems'] >= 1 and p['changed'] == 0, p

p, q = ${tp2}, ${tp1}
assert p['changed'] == 5 and p['problems'] == 1 and p['config_version'] > q['config_version'], (p, q)

p = ${tp3}
assert p['page'] == 'runs' and p['changed'] == 4 and p['problems'] == 0, p

import time
t = time.monotonic()
while app.actions.run('train.status').get('observe') is None:
    assert time.monotonic() - t < 180.0, app.actions.run('train.status')
    app.update(True)
print('SERVING', app.actions.run('train.status')['epoch'])

import time
t = time.monotonic()
while app.actions.run('train.status').get('epoch', 0) < 2:
    assert time.monotonic() - t < 180.0, app.actions.run('train.status')
    app.update(True)

p = ${tp4}
print('RUNNING', p)
assert p['run'] == 'base' and p['training'] == 'base' and p['runs'] == 1 and p['log_lines'] > 0, p
assert [s['run'] for s in p['series']] == ['base'] and p['series'][0]['rows'] >= 2, p

c = app.actions.run('view.camera')
app.actions.run('view.camera', target=c['target'], distance=3.0, yaw=35.0, pitch=24.0)
for _ in range(12):
    app.update(True)
o = app.actions.run('train.observe')
print('OBSERVING', o['frames'], len(o['arrows']), app.actions.run('train.status')['epoch'])
assert o['on'] and o['follow'] and len(o['arrows']) == 16, o

s = ${s1}
assert s['name'] == 'low_lr' and s['state'] == 'finished' and s['epoch'] == 3, s

p = ${tp5}
assert p['page'] == 'dashboard' and p['run'] == 'base' and p['compare'] == ['low_lr'], p
assert p['runs'] == 2 and p['training'] == '', p
assert p['series'] == [{'run': 'base', 'rows': 6}, {'run': 'low_lr', 'rows': 3}], p['series']

p = ${tp7}
k = app.actions.run('train.checkpoints', name='base')['checkpoints']
print('SAVES', [(c['kind'], c['epoch']) for c in k])
assert [(c['kind'], c['epoch']) for c in k if c['epoch'] == 6 and c['kind'] != 'best'] == [('epoch', 6), ('final', 6)], k
assert p['page'] == 'checkpoints' and p['run'] == 'base' and p['saves'] == len({c['policy'] for c in k}) >= 4, (p, k)

import builtins
builtins.played_q = [j['q'] for j in app.actions.run('robot.joints')['joints']]

import builtins
q = [j['q'] for j in app.actions.run('robot.joints')['joints']]
s = app.policy.status()
moved = max(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(builtins.played_q, q))
print('PLAYED', ${p0}['policy'], round(moved, 3), round(s['action_norm'], 3))
assert s['loaded'] and s['obs_dim'] == 48 and s['action_norm'] > 0.0 and moved > 0.01, (moved, s)
